name: Operation "The Big Bang"
description: A global crossfaction Ingress operation held on 31 July 2020. Agents from both factions built link stars from a single portal and submitted their results, portal details and photos through a Google Form. Imported into Brill Ops as the platform's first archived campaign.
date_basis: Campaign name in the original spreadsheet is 'Operation "The Big Bang" - July 31st, 2020 (Responses)' (visible in Txt/Screen Shot 2020-08-06 at 2.39.48.png). Submissions continued into early August; end_date reflects the event, not the submission window.
submission_window_end_basis: latest statistics screenshot in the handoff package is dated 2020-08-06
hero_image_basis: No campaign branding was supplied. Candidate: Videos/TheBigBang.mp4 poster frame.
original_submission_method: Google Form -> Google Sheet ("OP \"The Big Bang\" (Responses)")
